name: Get easy quotes for WP Development project
author: wpspin

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/get-easy-quotes-for-wp-development-project directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access the calculator from the admin menu labeled ‘WP-Dev Cost Calculator.’
sections.faq:
Where can I find submitted projects?

Navigate to ‘WP-Dev Cost Calculator’ > ‘All Projects’ in the WordPress admin dashboard.

How is my data handled?

Data is either emailed to estimates@wpspins.com with user consent or generated as a downloadable file for external use.
sections.description:
Easily get quotes for WordPress projects by sharing structured requirements for themes, plugins, troubleshooting, and support.

Plugin Description & Benefits

How It Works

  • Simple Project Form – Users fill out a form with basic details about their project. The plugin ensures all necessary information is captured, helping developers provide accurate quotes.
  • Essential Data Collection – The form asks for details commonly required by developers, reducing unnecessary back-and-forth communication.
  • Screen Recording Option – Users can record their screen to show errors, demonstrate issues, or explain their requests more effectively.
  • Multiple Quote Requests – Users can request quotes for:
    • Theme or plugin development
    • Troubleshooting WordPress issues
    • General support questions
  • Structured Requirement File Generation – Once the form is filled, the plugin organizes the information into a structured file that can be shared with any developer.
  • Instant Quote Option – With one click, users can send their request directly to our team at estimates@wpspins.com for a fast estimate.
  • User Notification & Data Transparency – Before submitting to our team, users are notified about what details will be sent, ensuring full control over their information.
  • Project History in Dashboard – Submitted projects are stored in the user’s dashboard, allowing them to reference or update them in the future.

Why Use This Plugin?

  • Saves Time – No more explaining the same details repeatedly. The structured requirement file ensures developers have all the necessary information upfront.
  • Accurate Quotes – By providing comprehensive details, users receive precise estimates without unnecessary delays.
  • Better Communication – The ability to record screens makes it easier to demonstrate issues or explain requirements visually.
  • Effortless Quote Requests – Instantly send requirements to our team for a fast estimate, or share the structured file with any developer of choice.
  • Project Tracking – Keep a history of all project requests in the backend for future reference.

This plugin is a must-have tool for WordPress users looking for a streamlined way to get development support, troubleshoot issues, and receive fast, accurate quotes from developers.

Features

  • Admin menu integration with WPSPIN branding
  • Conditional form fields based on project type
  • Data submission via email or local file generation
  • Custom post type to store project submissions
  • Admin interface to manage and view project details
